$comment: ACM type:style -> the wp-ja-essence pattern that renders it, field by field, for the seeder (seed.mjs renderAcm, `${type}:${style}`). Field names are the Joomla ACM field names VERBATIM. metadata.name is <type>.<field>[.<n>]; the wrapper of a repeated row is <type>.item.<n>. Social items: the button text is the service title and `font-icon` rides as the button class `je-icon-<service>` after tools/fix-spec.mjs rewrites it (S-02); core/social-link cannot take a link from the seeder.

views.$comment: search is com_finder at /pages/j-pages/smart-search on the source; the theme answers that path with its search view (inc/extra.php wp_ja_essence_search_request), so the seeder adds no redirect for it. author and tag are the source's own components (the people of the site, the filterable list of titles): the theme registers a dynamic block for each (inc/extra.php) and the seeder draws it as the body of the view.
